evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: This paper addresses the problem of visual grounding uncertainties, where a robot uses a black-box vision-language model (VLM) to ground free-form natural-language instructions to target objects.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: An external surrogate Bayesian model then quantifies per-query uncertainty over a local neighborhood of a held-out calibration set, decomposed into aleatoric and epistemic components.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: On a real Fetch robot under open-world instructions, it enables principled trade-offs between confident action and information gathering, substantially improving robustness.
